public_input.query: My partner and I are heading to London for a quick 2-day trip. We have a strict mid-range budget—no cheap budget places, but no upscale spots either. We prefer eating where the locals eat, so we'd like to include at least two places known for that. We also enjoy striking buildings, so we'd like to visit at least one spot known for architecture and city skylines. To keep our daily travel simple, we don't want to hop across more than two districts on any given day.
